programme.desc: Una combinación que contrasta la comedia romántica con el drama, de la manera que sólo Woody Allen, entre todos los cineastas, podría lograr. Se ubica en Manhattan y narra la crónica de una crisis vista en dos ángulos diferentes.
programme.title: Melinda y Melinda
Melinda and Melinda

programme.desc: Simon Spiers es un joven de 16 años que tiene una vida. Pero tiene un secreto: es gay. Cuando un día uno de sus e-mails cae en manos equivocadas, Simon verá cómo las cosas se complican extraordinariamente.
programme.title: Yo soy Simón
Love, Simon

programme.desc: Es Navidad y el teniente John McLane espera en el aeropuerto de Dulles la llegada de su esposa. Al mismo tiempo, un militar expulsado del Congreso planea liberar, en las cercanías del aeropuerto, a un dictador y traficante sudamericano.
programme.title: Duro de matar 2
Die Hard 2

programme.desc: La hipocresía de muchos personajes que viven una vida en la gran ciudad.
programme.title: Homo Argentum

programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op. 94; Frédéric Chopin’s Impromptu No. 3, Op. 51, Polonaise No. 6, Op. 53 “Heroic”, and Waltz No. 6, Op. 64 No. 1; Camille Saint-Saëns’s Polonaise for two pianos, Op. 77; César Franck’s Sonata for violin and piano in A major; and Fritz Kreisler’s Liebesleid and Schön Rosmarin. This performance was recorded on June 12, 2021.
programme.title: Shostakovich - Concertino for two pianos

programme.desc: The National Philharmonic Orchestra of Russia and acclaimed Russian pianist Boris Berezovsky are conducted by Konstantin Khvatynets in an interpretation of works by Rachmaninov and George Gershwin from Moscow's Tchaikovsky Concert Hall.
programme.title: Rachmaninov & Gershwin: Rhapsodies

programme.desc: Unusual Orchestral Colors and Effects. The use of less common instruments and the fresh soundscapes Mahler creates, lead to a rich and unique listening experience.
programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 7

programme.desc: Andreas Spering conducts Philharmonie Zuidnederland in a performance of "Overture Rosamunde" (D. 644), by Franz Schubert (1797-1828). Recorded in Muziekgebouw Eindhoven, The Netherlands in 2015.
programme.title: Schubert - Overture to Rosamunde (D. 644)

programme.desc: Dutch choreographer Hans van Manen (1932) is internationally recognized as one of the grand masters of contemporary ballet. In the documentary ‘Hans van Manen – Moving to Music’ (2022), Van Manen reflects on his life, work, and the inspirations behind ballets charged with drama and eroticism. The film features excerpts from some of his most successful ballets.
programme.title: Hans van Manen – Moving to Music

programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 6 in F major, Op. 68, also known as the Pastoral Symphony. This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2015.
programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 6 in F major, Op. 68

programme.desc: Maestro Herbert Blomstedt makes his debut with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra at 2020’s Lucerne Festival conducting Ludwig van Beethoven’s celebrated Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, “Eroica”. This performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.
programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55

programme.desc: Maestro Herbert Blomstedt makes his debut with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra at 2020’s Lucerne Festival conducting Ludwig van Beethoven’s celebrated Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, “Eroica”. This performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.
programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55

programme.desc: The Vienna-based IMZ International Music + Media Centre, a global association for all those involved in any aspect of classical and contemporary music, world music, jazz, and dance, celebrated its 50th anniversary in 2015. To commemorate this, renowned film maker Reiner E. Moritz produced the documentary 'Music in the air' to shed light on the history of classical music on television.
programme.title: Music in the air

programme.desc: The soloists of the Lucerne Festival Orchestra present two septets in this entertaining 2020 concert, recorded at Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland. The concert opens with Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Divertimento No. 11 in D major, K. 251, also known as the ‘Nannerl-Septet’. This is followed by Ludwig van Beethoven’s Septet in E-flat major, Op. 20.
programme.title: Beethoven - Septet in E-flat major, Op. 20

programme.desc: This chamber music concert is part of ‘Preludio’ concert series of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid. This performance was recorded at Auditorio Sony of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid, Spain, on April 30, 2024.
programme.title: Chamber music by Haydn, Tchaikovsky and others

programme.desc: The documentary “Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète” (2017) tells the remarkable life story of Romanian pianist Clara Haskil (1895-1960). Born in Bucharest into a Jewish family, she began her career as a child prodigy, entering the Bucharest Conservatory at a very young age. Haskil suffered from chronic health issues and lived through two world wars, which held back her career. Only after WWII, Haskil’s fame began to take off and she finally enjoyed international recognition.
programme.title: Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète

programme.desc: Riccardo Frizza conducts the Orchestra Gli Originali and the Coro Donizetti Opera in a performance of Geatano Donizetti’s comic opera L’elisir d’amore (‘The Elixer of Love’, 1832). Directed by Frederic Wake-Walker, this 2021 production is unique as it features the complete, original score as reconstructed by Alberto Zedda based on Donizetti’s autographs. In addition, the orchestra plays on historical instruments to recreate the sound of Donizetti’s orchestra. Among the soloists are Caterina Sala (Adina), Javier Camarena (Nemorino), Florian Sempey (Belcore), Roberto Frontali (Dulcamara), Anaïs Mejías (Giannetta), and Manuel Ferreira (Master of ceremonies). This performance was part of the Donizetti Opera Festival, recorded at Teatro Donizetti in Bergamo, Italy, in 2021.
programme.title: Donizetti - L’elisir d’amore

programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op. 94; Frédéric Chopin’s Impromptu No. 3, Op. 51, Polonaise No. 6, Op. 53 “Heroic”, and Waltz No. 6, Op. 64 No. 1; Camille Saint-Saëns’s Polonaise for two pianos, Op. 77; César Franck’s Sonata for violin and piano in A major; and Fritz Kreisler’s Liebesleid and Schön Rosmarin. This performance was recorded on June 12, 2021.
programme.title: Saint-Saëns - Polonaise for two pianos, Op. 77

programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker is one of the world’s finest orchestras, its fame stretching all the way to Japan. Unsurprisingly, this 2000 concert, recorded at Tokyo’s magnificent Suntory Hall, was a resounding success.
programme.title: Von Weber - Overture to Oberon

programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music. This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven’s String Quartet No. 6 in B-flat major, Op. 18 No. 6; and String Quartet No. 15 in A minor, Op. 132. This concert performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on November 24, 2020.
programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartet No. 15, Op. 132

programme.desc: Paul McCreesh conducts the Orquesta Gulbenkian and Coro Infantil da Academia de Música de Sana Cecília in a performance of Benjamin Britten’s War Requiem. Soloists are Tatiana Pavlovskaya (soprano), John Mark Ainsley (tenor) and Hanno Müller-Brachmann (bass).
programme.title: Britten - War Requiem

programme.desc: Conducted by Andreas Spering, the South Netherlands Philharmonic performs Beethoven’s Sixth Symphony. Ludwig van Beethoven painted in his symphony the rustic idylls of a peasants’ picnic in the countryside, rife with murmuring brooks and a frightful thunderstorm.
programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 6

programme.desc: This ‘In Rehearsal’ episode features the Finnish composer and conductor Esa-Pekka Salonen rehearsing Claude Debussy's Impressionistic orchestral piece La Mer with the Los Angeles Philharmonic at the Dorothy Chandler Pavilion of the Music Center of Los Angeles County. It gives a fascinating insight into Salonen’s rapport with his musicians and also into Debussy’s masterpiece.
programme.title: In Rehearsal: Esa-Pekka Salonen

programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2014.
programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67

programme.desc: Olivier Latry, the current holder of the Great Organ of Notre Dame, plays Pierre Cochereau’s Boléro, Louis Vierne’s Carillon of Westminster and Scherzo from Symphony No. 2, Alexandre Guilmant’s Sonata No. 1, and more.
programme.title: In the Organ's Stomach

programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 4 in B-flat major, Op. 60. This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2014.
programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 4 in B-flat major, Op. 60

programme.desc: Robert Schumann wrote Carnaval, Op. 9 in 1834–1835. It consists of 21 short pieces representing masked revelers at Carnival, a festival before Lent. Schumann gives musical expression to himself, his friends and colleagues, and characters from improvised Italian comedy (commedia dell'arte). Acclaimed pianist Riccardo Schwartz (1986) has performed as a soloist with many world-renowned conductors, including Gustav Kuhn and Yuri Temirkanov. His acclaimed performances include recitals and concertos for piano and orchestra in many prestigious concert halls.
programme.title: Schumann - Carnaval, Op. 9

programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. As part of the festival’s 2021 edition, maestro Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a wonderful concert program featuring Johannes Brahms’s Tragic Overture in D minor, Op. 81, and Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 1 in D major, ‘Titan’. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.
programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 1 in D major, ‘Titan’

programme.desc: Pianist Jaeden Izik-Dzurko (Canada, 1999) joins the CMIM ensemble, consisting of three principal strings players of the Montreal Symphony Orchestra, in a performance of the first movement, Sostenuto assai – Allegro ma non troppo, of Robert Schumann’s Piano Quartet in E-flat major, Op. 47. This performance took place during the chamber music round of the two-part semi-final of the Piano Edition of the Concours musical international de Montréal 2024 (CMIM). It was recorded at the Bourgie Hall of the Montreal Museum of Fine Arts.
programme.title: CMIM Piano 2024 - Semi-final I: Jaeden Izik-Dzurko

programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in a performance of Mahler's Symphony No. 6. The concert is Rattle's last time as chief conductor of the orchestra. On 14 November 1987, it was also the first work Rattle conducted when he debuted with the Berlin Philharmonic.
programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 6

programme.desc: Maestro Myung-Whun Chung leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino, along with two vocal soloists, in this impressive performance of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 2 in C minor, ‘Resurrection’. Soprano Christiane Karg and alto Claudia Huckle are the soloists. Written between 1888 and 1894, this five-movement symphony is scored for a large orchestra, chorus, and soprano and alto soloists. Mahler explores themes of life, death, and resurrection throughout the symphony. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.
programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 2, 'Resurrection'

programme.desc: Robert Schumann composed his Fantasie in C, Op. 17 in 1836, revising it prior to publication in 1839. Bearing a dedication to Franz Liszt, it is one of Schumann's greatest works for solo piano, and a central work of the early Romantic period. Written in a loose sonata form, the first movement is rhapsodic and passionate, the middle movement is a grandiose rondo, and the finale is slow and meditative. Acclaimed pianist Riccardo Schwartz (1986) has performed as a soloist with many world-renowned conductors, including Gustav Kuhn and Yuri Temirkanov. His acclaimed performances include recitals and concertos for piano and orchestra in many prestigious concert halls.
programme.title: Schumann - Fantasie in C, Op. 17

programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21. Soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin. This concert was part of the celebration of Chopin's 200th anniversary in 2010.
programme.title: Chopin - Piano Concerto No. 2, Op. 21

programme.desc: In this 2018 concert, the Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra is lead by Canadian conductor and pianist Yannick Nézet-Séguin in a performance of Dmitri Shostakovich's Symphony No. 4 in C minor, Op. 43.
programme.title: Shostakovich - Symphony No. 4 in C minor, Op. 43

programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 present Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 4 in G major, BWV 1049.
programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 4

programme.desc: One of the world’s most popular pieces of classical music, Maurice Ravel’s Boléro (1928), was no longer copyrighted as of May 1, 2016. Up to then it had made Ravel and his heirs millions. Ravel died in 1937 and left all he owned to his brother Edouard. Edouard’s death in 1960 unleashed a complex legal battle over the rights, involving among others Edouard’s nurse and her husband. This 2017 documentary gives a fascinating account of what happened to one this iconic piece of music right under the nose of the public. Filmmaker Fabien Caux-Lahalle underpins this investigative story with clips of the Boléro in various guises.
programme.title: Who has stolen the Boléro by Maurice Ravel?

programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in this concert recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on April 21, 2016. The program includes Felix Mendelssohn’s concert overture Die Hebriden, Op. 26 (The Hebrides); Edvard Grieg’s Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16, featuring Pascal Amoyel as the pianist; and Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 7 in A major, Op. 92.
programme.title: Grieg - Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16

programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. This performance was recorded at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany.
programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concertos, BWV 1046-1051

programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam, recorded in De Doelen, Rotterdam, in 2018. Alvaro Siviero is the soloist in Grieg's Piano Concerto No. 1.
programme.title: Grieg - Piano Concerto, Op. 16

programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven's Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21. This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2014.
programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21

programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of two great works. Paganini’s Violin Concerto No. 1. is paired with Brahms’ dramatic symphonic debut, Symphony No.1. This exceptional performance features the dazzling virtuosity of violinist In Mo Yang, winner of the 2015 Paganini Competition.
programme.title: Luisi conducts Paganini's Violin Concerto & Brahms

programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra in an exciting concert program consisting of works by J. S. Bach, Béla Bartók, and Johannes Brahms. The program opens with Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 3 in G major, BWV 1048. This is followed by one of Bartók’s best-known pieces: Music for strings, percussion and celesta. The program ends with Brahms’s Symphony No. 3 in F major, Op. 90. This performance was recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary, on December 4, 2017.
programme.title: Works by Bach, Bartók, and Brahms

programme.desc: Indian conductor Zubin Mehta (1936) became Music Director of the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra (IPO) in 1977 and was appointed Music Director for Life in 1981. On July 18, 1996, Mehta led the IPO in its first-ever performance of Richard Strauss’s tone poem Till Eulenspiegels lustige Streiche, Op. 28. This episode of ‘In Rehearsal’ offers an intimate look at the dialogue between Mehta and the musicians as they explore Strauss’s tone poem together.
programme.title: In Rehearsal: Zubin Mehta

programme.desc: This live performance marks Fabio Luisi’s very first concert with the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in DR Koncerthuset, Copenhagen. Beethoven’s milestone Eroica symphony is paired with Stravinsky’s mighty Symphony of Psalms and Strauss’ virtuosic Don Juan.
programme.title: Stravinsky - Symphony of Psalms

programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform a wonderful recital of works by Ferruccio Busoni, Franz Liszt, Frédéric Chopin, and Sergei Rachmaninoff.
programme.title: Busoni - Kultaselle, 10 Variations

programme.desc: Luca Vignali (oboe), Angelo De Angelis (clarinet), Carmine Pinto (horn), Eliseo Smordoni (bassoon), and Linda Di Carlo (piano) perform Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Quintet for piano and winds in E-flat major, K. 452. This performance was recorded at Perugia’s Auditorium Santa Cecilia, Italy, on June 23, 2022.
programme.title: Mozart - Quintet for piano and winds, K. 452

programme.desc: Argentinian conductor and harpsichordist Leonardo García Alarcón leads his ensemble Cappella Mediterranea in a program of Italian Baroque music. Argentinian soprano Mariana Flores presents the vocal works. This performance was recorded at the magnificent Église Notre-Dame of Sablé-sur-Sarthe, France, on August 26, 2020.
programme.title: Vocal baroque works by Cavalli, Strozzi & Bembo

programme.desc: French violinist Renaud Capuçon appears at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, presenting a chamber music program consisting of classical and 20th century repertoire. He performs with the soloists of the International Menuhin Music Academy led by French conductor Jean-Jacques Kantorow. On the program are Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Sinfonia Concertante in E-flat major, K. 364, Mozart’s Sonata for violin and piano in E minor, K. 304, and Dmitri Shostakovich’s Chamber Symphony in C minor, Op. 110a.
programme.title: Chamber music by Mozart and Shostakovich

programme.desc: The Vienna-based IMZ International Music + Media Centre, a global association for all those involved in any aspect of classical and contemporary music, world music, jazz, and dance, celebrated its 50th anniversary in 2015. To commemorate this, renowned film maker Reiner E. Moritz produced the documentary 'Music in the air' to shed light on the history of classical music on television.
programme.title: Music in the air

programme.desc: Marco Sollini, Salvatore Barbatano.
programme.title: Liszt - Due Poemi Sinfonici

programme.desc: Maestro Myung-Whun Chung leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in this touching performance of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 9 in D major. Written in 1908-1909, it was the last symphony Mahler completed. Symphony No. 9 premiered on June 26, 1912, in Vienna, performed by the Vienna Philharmonic led by Bruno Walter. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.
programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 9

programme.desc: Musicians of the Reina Sofía School of Music pay tribute to the rich musical heritage of Czechia in this chamber concert. The program features works by Bedřich Smetana, Leoš Janáček, Josef Suk and Antonín Dvořák. This performance was recorded at Auditorio Sony of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid, Spain, on November 28, 2024.
programme.title: Works by Smetana, Janáček, Suk and Dvořák

programme.desc: The documentary “The Three Lives of Clara Schumann” traces the fascinating life story of German pianist and composer Clara Schumann. Basing itself on her letters and diaries, her compositions, and on accounts from musicians who have intensively studied her music, this 2019 documentary offers a multi-angled perspective on Clara Schumann.
programme.title: The Three Lives of Clara Schumann

programme.desc: English-French pianist David Levy performs Dmitri Shostakovich’s 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87. The work is a set of twenty-four pieces for piano, one in each of the major and minor keys of the chromatic scale. This performance was recorded at the Budapest Music Center, Hungary, in September 2023.
programme.title: Shostakovich - 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87

programme.desc: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor, Op. 37. Russian-born pianist Maya Oganyan (*2005) makes her solo debut with the orchestra. As an encore, Oganyan performs Der Bote (‘The Messenger’) by Ukrainian composer Valentin Silvestrov. This performance was recorded at the Aram Khachaturian Concert Hall in Yerevan, Armenia, in 2021.
programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor

programme.desc: Set to the magnificent compositions of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky, The Sleeping Beauty retells the classic fairy tale love story through sublime world class ice dancing, breathtaking high speed lifts and throws, awe-inspiring aerial gymnastics and fire effects in a choreography by the award-winning Tony Mercer, all in the enchanting setting of a theater stage. Performed by a cast of world class ice skaters, holding more than 300 competition medals between them, this wintery spin on one of the most famous fairy tales of all time enchants with creative and powerful story-telling, sumptuous sets, spectacular special effects and opulent costumes. Recorded 2013 at the Teatro Montecasino in Johannesburg, South Africa.
programme.title: Ice Dance: Sleeping Beauty (2013)

programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform a wonderful recital of works by Ferruccio Busoni, Franz Liszt, Frédéric Chopin, and Sergei Rachmaninoff.
programme.title: Liszt - Elegies No. 1 and 2 (S. 130 & 131)

programme.desc: Mahler's 9th Symphony captivates through its profound emotional depth and vulnerability, especially the breathtakingly beautiful and spiritually resonant Adagio that concludes the work, offering a profound sense of closure and transcendence.
programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 9

programme.desc: The documentary 'Heavenly Voices – The Legacy of Farinelli' (2012) tells us the story of the castrato in music – male singers who were castrated at a young age in order to preserve their high vocal range, a cruel practice that was in place mainly in the 17th and 18th centuries. In this documentary, countertenors Max Emanuel Cenčić, Philippe Jaroussky, Andreas Scholl, Franco Fagioli, and Jochen Kowalski discuss Baroque-era operatic entertainment. 'Heavenly Voices' is a film by Gino Pennacchi (writer) and Alessandro Scillitani (director).
programme.title: Heavenly Voices - The legacy of Farinelli

programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Musica del Palacia de Mineria in a performance of Carl Orff's Carmina Burana. Soloists are Anabel de la Mora (soprano), Andrés Carrillo (tenor) and Cerón (bariton).
programme.title: Orff - Carmina Burana

programme.desc: American conductor Leonard Slatkin leads the Orchestre National de Lyon in a concert recorded at the Auditorium de Lyon in 2014. The concert opens with William Bolcom´s Circus Ouverture, which was specially composed for Slatkin's 70th birthday. The concert continues with a performance of Beethoven's Triple Concerto in C, Op. 56.
programme.title: Slatkin conducts Bolcom, Beethoven & Ravel

programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Piano Sonata No. 2 in G minor, Op. 22. The composer completed the work in 1838. Of Schumann’s three piano sonatas, Piano Sonata No. 2 is performed and recorded most frequently.
programme.title: Schumann - Piano Sonata No. 2 in G minor, Op. 22

programme.desc: This unique production of Carl Maria von Weber’s 'Der Freischütz' was created to celebrate both the piece’s 200th premiere anniversary at Konzerthaus Berlin and the 200th anniversary of the famed concert hall itself. Christoph Eschenbach conducts Konzerthausorchester Berlin and Rundfunkchor Berlin in this 2021 performance.
programme.title: Von Weber - Der Freischütz

programme.desc: The Royal Ballet Flanders performs ballets on music by Ravel by choreographers Sidi Larbi Cherkaoui and Jeroen Verbruggen. The Symphonic Orchestra of the Opera Vlaanderen is conducted by Yannis Pouspourikas. Recorded in the Opera Antwerp, in 2016.
programme.title: Ravel by Cherkaoui/Verbruggen

programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music. This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven’s String Quartet No. 6 in B-flat major, Op. 18 No. 6; and String Quartet No. 15 in A minor, Op. 132. This concert performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on November 24, 2020.
programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartets No. 6 and 15

programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op. 94; Frédéric Chopin’s Impromptu No. 3, Op. 51, Polonaise No. 6, Op. 53 “Heroic”, and Waltz No. 6, Op. 64 No. 1; Camille Saint-Saëns’s Polonaise for two pianos, Op. 77; César Franck’s Sonata for violin and piano in A major; and Fritz Kreisler’s Liebesleid and Schön Rosmarin. This performance was recorded on June 12, 2021.
programme.title: Franck - Sonata for violin and piano

programme.desc: As part of the ‘Da Camera’ concert series of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid, the Spanish Grupo Fundación Mutua Madrileña performs Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 1 in D major, ‘Titan’, in an arrangement for chamber orchestra by conductor Francisco Alonso Serena. This performance was recorded at Auditorio Sony of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid, Spain, on May 30, 2023.
programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 1 for chamber orchestra

programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in this concert recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on April 21, 2016. The program includes Felix Mendelssohn’s concert overture Die Hebriden, Op. 26 (The Hebrides); Edvard Grieg’s Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16, featuring Pascal Amoyel as the pianist; and Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 7 in A major, Op. 92.
programme.title: Grieg's Piano Concerto & Beethoven Symphony No. 7

programme.desc: Russian conductor and pianist Mikhail Pletnev leads the Russian National Orchestra in performances of Nikolai Rimsky-Korsakov's music. On the program are Suite for Orchestra after the opera 'The Legend of the Invisible City of Kitezh and the Maiden Fevroniya', and Musical Pictures for Orchestra from the opera 'The Tale of Tsar Saltan'.
programme.title: Mikhail Pletnev conducts Rimski-Korsakov

programme.desc: The 2019 documentary ‘Approaching the Maelström’ follows the process leading up to a recording of American composer Philip Glass’s composition ‘A Descent into the Maelström’. The work is based on American writer Edgar Allan Poe’s 1841 short story of two fishermen caught in torrents raging between the mountainous islands of Lofoten, Norway. Glass’s work, originally a choral piece for the Australian Dance Theatre, was only ever performed at the Adelaide Festival of Arts in 1986.
programme.title: Approaching the Maelström

programme.desc: Michael Tilson Thomas conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a pleasing performance of Tchaikovsky's folk-infused Symphony No. 2 - the 'Little Russian'. This performance is recorded at St. Luke's London on May 31st, 2021.
programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 2, Op. 17

programme.desc: In this episode of ‘In Rehearsal,’ Latvian maestro Mariss Jansons guides the Oslo Philharmonic through the powerful Suite from Béla Bartók’s pantomime ballet The Miraculous Mandarin, culminating in a performance at the Oslo Concert Hall.
programme.title: In Rehearsal: Mariss Jansons

programme.desc: Hartmut Haenchen conducts the philharmonie zuid in a performance of Richard Danielpour's Elegies. Soloists are Marina Prudenskaya (mezzo-soprano), Thomas Oliemans (baritone). Recorded at Muziekgebouw Eindhoven, The Netherlands, 2019.
programme.title: Danielpour - Elegies

programme.desc: Pianist Alexandre Tharaud's interpretation of Beethoven's last three sonatas - Opus 109, 110 and 111.
programme.title: Beethoven - Last Sonatas, Op. 109, 110 & 111

programme.desc: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs two of J. S. Bach’s incredible works for solo violin: Partita No. 2 in D minor (BWV 1004), and Sonata No. 3 in C major (BWV 1005). In this wonderful performance, Faust shows her mastery of Bach’s technically challenging pieces. This performance was recorded at St. Thomas Church in Leipzig, Germany, in 2020.
programme.title: Bach - Partita for Violin No. 2 (BWV 1004)

programme.desc: Pianist Carter Johnson (Canada, 1996) joins the CMIM ensemble, consisting of three principal strings players of the Montreal Symphony Orchestra, in a performance of the first movement, Sostenuto assai – Allegro ma non troppo, of Robert Schumann’s Piano Quartet in E-flat major, Op. 47. This performance took place during the chamber music round of the two-part semi-final of the Piano Edition of the Concours musical international de Montréal 2024 (CMIM). It was recorded at the Bourgie Hall of the Montreal Museum of Fine Arts.
programme.title: CMIM Piano 2024 - Semi-final I: Carter Johnson

programme.desc: Pianist Vadim Repin and Violist Murad Hüseynov perform Gara Garayev's Violin Sonata and 24 Preludes for Piano. Recorded at La Grange ay Lac. Written and directed by Juliette Swierczewski and recorded at La Grange au Lac. Although Garayev is a 20th century composer, his music nonetheless carries allusions to romantic music.
programme.title: Gara Garayev : Autumn Sonatas

programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle and the London Symphony Orchestra mark 150 years since the death of Hector Berlioz with his tempestuous oratorio, La damnation de Faust.
programme.title: Berlioz - The Damnation of Faust

programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Mahler's Symphony No. 8. The work is one of the largest-scale choral works in the classical concert repertoire and is frequently called the "Symphony of a Thousand". Recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, 2017.
programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 8

programme.desc: Explore the captivating sounds of epic gaming worlds brought to life by 150 musicians and singers at DR Koncerthuset. The Danish National Symphony Orchestra transforms the stage into enchanted musical landscapes inspired by legendary video games such as The Legend of Zelda and League of Legends, featuring Nordic vocalist Eivør as a special guest in Legends Never Die and more.
programme.title: Gaming X Symphony - Legends & Quests

programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Lily Maisky and Iddo Bar-Shaï, violinists Tedi Papavrami and Akiko Suwanai, her daughter Lyda Chen-Argerich on viola, and cellist Mischa Maisky. On the program are Felix Mendelssohn’s Piano Trio No. 1 in D minor, Op. 49; Leoš Janáček’s Violin Sonata; Franz Schubert’s Rondo in A major, D. 951; and Johannes Brahms’s Piano Quartet No. 3 in C minor, Op. 60. These performances were recorded on May 4 and June 13, 2021.
programme.title: Schubert - Rondo D. 951

programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Sergei Prokofiev’s Peter and the Wolf, Op. 67. Written in 1936, Peter and the Wolf is a short, narrated orchestral suite, telling the story of a brave boy named Peter, who lives with his grandfather on the edge of a forest. With the help of his animal friends, Peter outsmarts a villainous wolf and captures it, eventually leading it to the zoo.
programme.title: Prokofiev - Peter and the Wolf

programme.desc: Ukrainian-born pianist Inna Faliks performs Frederic Chopin's Polonaise-Fantaisie Op. 61. Recorded at the Nicols Concert Hall, Evanston, IL, USA. Faliks has established herself as one of the most communicative, and poetic artists of her generation. The Polonaise-Fantaise was dedicated to Mme A. Veyret, composed and published in 1846.
programme.title: Chopin - Polonaise-fantaisie, Op. 61

programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 10 is an unfinished work left by the composer at his death, representing his ultimate emotional journey from torment and heartbreak to an unreserved acceptance of life and human love.
programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 10

programme.desc: Lithuanian pianist Vadim Chaimovich (*1978) performs piano works by Anton Bruckner. On the program are Klavierstück in E-flat major, WAB 119, Erinnerung in A-flat major, WAB 117, Lancier-Quadrille Nos. 1, 2, 3 & 4 in C major, WAB 120, Steiermärker in G major, WAB 122, Stille Betrachtung an einem Herbstabend ('Quiet meditation on an autumn evening') in F-sharp minor, WAB 123, Fantasie in G major, WAB 118, and Piano sonata in G minor, WAB 243.
programme.title: Piano works by Bruckner

programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in Antonín Dvořák’s spirited Slavonic Dances, Op. 46 (Nos. 1-8). This performance was recorded at LSO St. Luke’s on Old Street in London, UK, on September 23, 2020.
programme.title: Dvořák – Slavonic Dances, Op. 46 (Nos. 1–8)

programme.desc: Conductor Herbert Blomstedt and the Gewandhausorchester take us on a musical journey to the Czech Republic in this 2020 concert from Leipzig’s Gewandhaus. The program opens with Bohemian composer Jan Václav Hugo Voríšek’s Symphony in D major, Op. 23 (1821). Also on the program is Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Symphony No. 38 in D major, K. 504, also know as the 'Prague Symphony'.
programme.title: Mozart - Symphony No. 38, K. 504

programme.desc: Superstar tenor Juan Diego Flórez brings to life the most iconic roles of the bel canto repertoire, joined by the vibrant young musicians of Sinfonía por el Perú, led by the celebrated conductor Ana María Patiño-Osorio!
programme.title: Sinfonía por el Perú from Philharmonie de Paris

programme.desc: This ‘In Rehearsal’ episode features the Finnish composer and conductor Esa-Pekka Salonen rehearsing Claude Debussy's Impressionistic orchestral piece La Mer with the Los Angeles Philharmonic at the Dorothy Chandler Pavilion of the Music Center of Los Angeles County. It gives a fascinating insight into Salonen’s rapport with his musicians and also into Debussy’s masterpiece.
programme.title: In Rehearsal: Esa-Pekka Salonen

programme.desc: In 2012, Norwegian opera director Stefan Herheim brought Giacomo Puccini's opera La bohème to the stage of the Norwegian National Opera in Oslo. Norwegian conductor Eivind Gullberg Jensen leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the National Opera Oslo. Among the soloists are Marita Sølberg (Mimì), Diego Torre (Rodolfo), Vasily Ladyuk (Marcello), and Jennifer Rowley (Musetta).
programme.title: Puccini - La bohème

programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birthday, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz performs Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op. 26 (Carnival Scenes from Vienna). Schumann composed most of the work during his stay in Vienna in 1839, where he wrote the first four movements, presenting pictures of lively carnival revelry. He completed the fifth, last movement on his return to Leipzig. This piano cycle is among the composer’s most popular.
programme.title: Schumann - Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op. 26

programme.desc: In Geneva, the city where she spent the most of her life, Martha Argerich invites her lifelong music partner, the cellist Mischa Maisky, to play in private chamber music. Between each piece, Martha opens up to her daughter Annie Dutoit, in an intimate interview that brings both their intimacy and the music.
programme.title: Chopin - Introduction & Polonaise, Op. 3

programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in a wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists. As part of this concert, violinist Tedi Papavrami, violist Lyda Chen-Argerich, cellist Mischa Maisky, and pianist Lily Maisky perform Johannes Brahms’s Piano Quartet No. 3 in C minor, Op. 60.
programme.title: Brahms - Piano Quartet No. 3 in C minor, Op. 60

programme.desc: It's going to be fast, really fast! All your favourite characters from the world of cartoons and animated films in the Concert Hall - together with a strong fusion of musicians and singers from DR's choirs and orchestras.
programme.title: Cartoons in Concert

programme.desc: Mahler: Das Lied von der Erde, performed live by Carlos Miguel Prieto conducting the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería, with mezzo-soprano Ruxandra Donose and tenor Ramón Vargas, presents Mahler’s song-symphony — one of the composer’s most profound masterpieces.
programme.title: Mahler – The Song of the Earth

programme.desc: Indian conductor Zubin Mehta (1936) became Music Director of the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra (IPO) in 1977 and was appointed Music Director for Life in 1981. On July 18, 1996, Mehta led the IPO in its first-ever performance of Richard Strauss’s tone poem Till Eulenspiegels lustige Streiche, Op. 28. This episode of ‘In Rehearsal’ offers an intimate look at the dialogue between Mehta and the musicians as they explore Strauss’s tone poem together.
programme.title: In Rehearsal: Zubin Mehta

programme.desc: “The Unanswered Ives” (2018) is the first documentary about American modernist composer Charles Ives (1874-1954). The documentary sheds light on Ives’s life and work in all its facets, exploring his aural world by showing music performances in churches, concert halls, open-air venues, and a circus tent. Using interviews with relatives, insurance brokers, musicologists, and musicians, documentary filmmaker Anne-Kathrin Peitz explores the question “who was Charles Ives?".
programme.title: The Unanswered Ives

programme.desc: Russian pianist Nikolay Lugansky has received world-wide praise for his interpretations of the music of Sergei Rachmaninoff. In this wonderful recital, the great pianist presents works by the Russian Romantic composer as well as Ludwig van Beethoven and Alexander Glazunov. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on June 4, 2021.
programme.title: Piano works by Rachmaninoff, Beethoven & Glazunov

programme.desc: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Hector Berlioz’s Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14. Berlioz wrote the piece of program music in 1830 while still a conservatory student. Inspired on the composer’s unrequited love for Irish actress Harriet Smithson, the five-movement piece portrays the dreams of a young artist who has taken an overdose of opium in the aftermath of a failed love affair. This performance was recorded at the Aram Khachaturian Concert Hall in Yerevan, Armenia, in 2021.
programme.title: Berlioz - Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14

programme.desc: In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021.
programme.title: Ravel - La Valse

programme.desc: At the behest of Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich, several classical music stars took part in this concert in aid of the Erasmus Fund for medical research in intensive care, recorded at the Royal Conservatory of Brussels, Belgium, on October 21, 2023. The concert pays tribute to the renowned cellist Aleksandr Khramouchin (1979) who suddenly passed away on May 13, 2023. As part of this concert, trumpetist Sergei Nakariakov and pianist Maria Meerovitch perform Lensky’s aria from Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s opera Eugene Onegin.
programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Lensky’s aria from Eugene Onegin

programme.desc: In Geneva, the city where she spent the most of her life, Martha Argerich invites her lifelong music partner, the cellist Mischa Maisky, to play in private chamber music. Between each piece, Martha opens up to her daughter Annie Dutoit, in an intimate interview that brings both their intimacy and the music.
programme.title: Beethoven - 7 Variations: 'Bei Männer..', WoO 46

programme.desc: The symphony's immense emotional scope, features innovative use of large-scale forces for breathtaking sound, and an ambitious philosophical journey that connects listeners to the grandeur of the natural world.
programme.title: Symphony No. 3, in D minor

programme.desc: Maestro Iván Fischer leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a remarkable concert program featuring Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Symphony No. 34 in C major, K. 338, and Antonín Dvořák’s Symphony No. 7 in D minor, Op. 70. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, on January 29, 2021.
programme.title: Dvořák - Symphony No. 7, Op. 70

programme.desc: Dutch choreographer Hans van Manen (1932) is internationally recognized as one of the grand masters of contemporary ballet. In this tribute to the great choreographer, dancers of the Dutch National Ballet perform three masterpieces from Van Manen’s extensive oeuvre. On the program are Metaforen (1965), Adagio Hammerklavier (1973), and Frank Bridge Variations (2005). This performance was recorded at Opéra Berlioz, Le Corum in Montpellier, France, in 2017.
programme.title: Tribute to Hans van Manen

programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Iddo Bar-Shaï, and Arielle Beck; violinists Gidon Kremer, Maxim Vengerov, and Tedi Papavrami; cellist Mischa Maisky, Flugelhorn player Sergei Nakariakov, as well as her daughter and grandson: Lyda Chen-Argerich (piano and viola) and David Chen-Argerich (piano). This performance was recorded on June 11, 2021.
programme.title: Schumann - Piano Quintet in E-flat major, Op. 44

programme.desc: Belgian conductor Jos van Immerseel leads Anima Eterna Brugge in a concert program dedicated to American composer George Gershwin. Soprano Claron McFadden features as the soloist, presenting a selection of Gershwin’s classic jazz songs. Pianist Bart Van Caenegem is the soloist in Gershwin’s celebrated Rhapsody in Blue. This performance was recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on March 3, 2017.
programme.title: Gershwin - Greatest Hits

programme.desc: The Vienna-based IMZ International Music + Media Centre, a global association for all those involved in any aspect of classical and contemporary music, world music, jazz, and dance, celebrated its 50th anniversary in 2015. To commemorate this, renowned film maker Reiner E. Moritz produced the documentary 'Music in the air' to shed light on the history of classical music on television.
programme.title: Music in the air

programme.desc: By popular demand, Canada's Ballet Jörgen reprises the tragic tale of the Russian Grand Duchess Anastasia, 10 years after the ballet's premiere and 100 years after Anastasia's story. Created by acclaimed choreographer Bengt Jörgen, the ballet is set to an original score for orchestra by Russian composer Ivan Barbotin.
programme.title: Anastasia

programme.desc: The National Philharmonic Orchestra of Russia and acclaimed Russian pianist Boris Berezovsky are conducted by Konstantin Khvatynets in an interpretation of works by Rachmaninov and George Gershwin from Moscow's Tchaikovsky Concert Hall.
programme.title: Rachmaninov & Gershwin: Rhapsodies

programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra (BFO) in a concert program dedicated to the music of Ludwig van Beethoven. The program opens with the composer’s Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21. Afterward, Fischer conducts Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 4 in G major, Op. 58, in which Richard Goode features as the soloist. The program closes with Beethoven’s famous Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. This performance was recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary, on January 29, 2017.
programme.title: Beethoven - Symphonies and Piano Concerto No. 4

programme.desc: Marta Gardolińska conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a concert program consisting of Lili Boulanger’s D’un Martin de Printemps, Marc-André Dalbavie’s Concerto for Flute (soloist is Gareth Davies), and Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36. This concert was recorded at LSO St Luke’s in London, UK, on May 18, 2022.
programme.title: The LSO performs Boulanger, Dalbavie & Tchaikovsky

programme.desc: In this episode of ‘In Rehearsal,’ Latvian maestro Mariss Jansons guides the Oslo Philharmonic through the powerful Suite from Béla Bartók’s pantomime ballet The Miraculous Mandarin, culminating in a performance at the Oslo Concert Hall.
programme.title: In Rehearsal: Mariss Jansons

programme.desc: In Tales of Two Cities, the Tafelmusik Baroque Orchestra celebrates the music and culture in eighteenth century coffee houses of Leipzig and Damascus with works by Bach, Telemann, Handel and classical Arabic music. Recorded at the Aga Khan Museum in Toronto.
programme.title: Tales of Two Cities: Leipzig-Damascus Coffee House

programme.desc: Pianist Derek Wang (USA, 1998) joins the CMIM ensemble, consisting of three principal strings players of the Montreal Symphony Orchestra, in a performance of the first movement, Allegro, of Johannes Brahms’s Piano Quartet No 1. in G minor, Op. 25. This performance took place during the chamber music round of the two-part semi-final of the Piano Edition of the Concours musical international de Montréal 2024 (CMIM). It was recorded at the Bourgie Hall of the Montreal Museum of Fine Arts.
programme.title: CMIM Piano 2024 - Semi-final I: Derek Wang

programme.desc: Argentinian cellist Sol Gabetta returned to the Lucerne Festival 2018 to perform a concert with the Mahler Chamber Orchestra led by François-Xavier Roth. Highlights are Martinů’s Cello Concerto No. 1 and Haydn’s Symphony No. 83.
programme.title: Sol Gabetta at the Lucerne Festival 2018

programme.desc: In May and June 2021, Argentinian star pianist Martha Argerich celebrated her 80th birthday performing at Château de Chantilly, France. In this concert, recorded at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, Argerich is joined by three musicians who are particularly close to her heart: cellist Mischa Maisky, violinist Maxim Vengerov, and pianist Iddo Bar-Shaï. They perform with the orchestra Les Siècles under the baton of Romanian-Austrian conductor Ion Marin. On the program are Ludwig van Beethoven’s Triple Concerto in C major, Op. 56, and Camille Saint-Saëns’s musical suite The Carnival of the Animals (Le carnaval des animaux). This performance was recorded at Château de Chantilly, on May 4, 2021.
programme.title: Works by Beethoven and Saint-Saëns

programme.desc: Dutch choreographer Hans van Manen (1932) is internationally recognized as one of the grand masters of contemporary ballet. In the documentary ‘Hans van Manen – Moving to Music’ (2022), Van Manen reflects on his life, work, and the inspirations behind ballets charged with drama and eroticism. The film features excerpts from some of his most successful ballets.
programme.title: Hans van Manen – Moving to Music

programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in this concert recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on April 21, 2016. The program includes Felix Mendelssohn’s concert overture Die Hebriden, Op. 26 (The Hebrides); Edvard Grieg’s Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16, featuring Pascal Amoyel as the pianist; and Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 7 in A major, Op. 92.
programme.title: Grieg - Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16

programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 10 is an unfinished work left by the composer at his death, representing his ultimate emotional journey from torment and heartbreak to an unreserved acceptance of life and human love.
programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 10

programme.desc: Venezuelan-born conductor Giovanni Guzzo leads the Camerata Fundación EDP of the Reina Sofía School of Music in a spirited concert. On the program are works by Christoph Willibald Gluck, J.S. Bach and W.A. Mozart. This performance was recorded at Auditorio Sony of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid, Spain, on December 18, 2024.
programme.title: Works by Gluck, Bach and Mozart

programme.desc: The documentary “Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète” (2017) tells the remarkable life story of Romanian pianist Clara Haskil (1895-1960). Born in Bucharest into a Jewish family, she began her career as a child prodigy, entering the Bucharest Conservatory at a very young age. Haskil suffered from chronic health issues and lived through two world wars, which held back her career. Only after WWII, Haskil’s fame began to take off and she finally enjoyed international recognition.
programme.title: Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète

programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform a wonderful recital of works by Ferruccio Busoni, Franz Liszt, Frédéric Chopin, and Sergei Rachmaninoff.
programme.title: Liszt - Elegie for Cello & Piano, No. 1 (S. 130)

programme.desc: As part of a new collaboration with the famous composer Philip Glass, French pianists Katia and Marielle Labèque perform the European premiere of Glass's Concerto for Two Pianos with the Orchester de Paris.
programme.title: Glass - Double Concerto for Two Pianos

programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra in an exciting concert program consisting of works by J. S. Bach, Béla Bartók, and Johannes Brahms. The program opens with Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 3 in G major, BWV 1048. This is followed by one of Bartók’s best-known pieces: Music for strings, percussion and celesta. The program ends with Brahms’s Symphony No. 3 in F major, Op. 90. This performance was recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary, on December 4, 2017.
programme.title: Works by Bach, Bartók, and Brahms

programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. This performance was recorded at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany.
programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concertos, BWV 1046-1051

programme.desc: French violinist Renaud Capuçon appears at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, presenting a chamber music program consisting of classical and 20th century repertoire. He performs with the soloists of the International Menuhin Music Academy led by French conductor Jean-Jacques Kantorow. On the program are Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Sinfonia Concertante in E-flat major, K. 364, Mozart’s Sonata for violin and piano in E minor, K. 304, and Dmitri Shostakovich’s Chamber Symphony in C minor, Op. 110a.
programme.title: Chamber music by Mozart and Shostakovich

programme.desc: At the behest of Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich, several classical music stars took part in this concert in aid of the Erasmus Fund for medical research in intensive care, recorded at the Royal Conservatory of Brussels, Belgium, on October 21, 2023. The concert pays tribute to the renowned cellist Aleksandr Khramouchin (1979) who suddenly passed away on May 13, 2023. As part of this concert, violinist Alissa Margulis, cellist Mischa Maisky, and pianist Lily Maisky perform Sergei Rachmaninoff’s Trio élégiaque No. 1 in G minor.
programme.title: Rachmaninoff - Trio élégiaque No. 1

programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 present Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 5 in D major, BWV 1050.
programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 5

programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Symphonic Etudes, Op. 13. Composed between 1834-37, the work began as a theme and a set of sixteen variations. The theme had been composed by Baron von Fricken, an amateur musician and father of Ernestine von Fricken, to whom Schumann was engaged in 1834.
programme.title: Schumann - Symphonic Etudes, Op. 13

programme.desc: Pianist Antonio Chen Guang (China, 1994) joins the CMIM ensemble in a performance of the first movement, Sostenuto assai – Allegro ma non troppo, of Robert Schumann’s Piano Quartet in E-flat major, Op. 47. This performance took place during the chamber music round of the two-part semi-final of the Piano Edition of the Concours musical international de Montréal 2024 (CMIM).
programme.title: CMIM Piano 2024 - Semi-final I: Antonio Chen Guang

programme.desc: In a 2019 performance from the Muziekgebouw in Eindhoven, Hartmut Haenchen conducts the philharmonie zuidnederland for this performance of Anton Bruckner’s Symphony No. 7. The majestic opening theme of the first movement of Anton Bruckner’s Symphony No. 7 foreshadows a momentous work, lasting over 20 minutes. The doubt and turmoil felt throughout the Adagio, the second movement, are supposedly Bruckner's response to the news of the death of his idol, Richard Wagner.
programme.title: Bruckner - Symphony No. 7

programme.desc: Young Venezuelan conductor Glass Marcano is a rising star. In this concert, recorded at Opéra de Tours in February 2021, Marcano leads the Orchestre Symphonique Région Centre-Val de Loire/Tours in performances of two Romantic masterpieces. The program opens with Ludwig van Beethoven’s Violin Concerto in D major, Op. 61, featuring Stéphanie-Marie Degand as the soloist. The program concludes with Georges Bizet’s 1855 Symphony in C major.
programme.title: Beethoven Violin Concerto & Bizet Symphony in C

programme.desc: Kim, una joven adicta al trabajo, llega a un punto de quiebre cuando su novio rompe con ella en lugar de proponerle matrimonio. Por ello, su madre la lleva a un retiro especial de Navidad para que se reconecte con el espíritu navideño.
programme.title: Retiro navideño
The Christmas Retreat

programme.desc: S1 E15 — Cómo entrenar a tu dragón 3 / Maligno / Todos lo saben Te mostramos el set y el backstage de las películas: Cómo entrenar a tu dragón 3, Maligno y Todos lo saben.
programme.title: Hollywood on Set

programme.desc: Semanas antes de Navidad, Abbey es contratada para decorar la finca del empresario Nick. Pero para hacer bien su trabajo, debe descubrir cómo derribar el muro entre ella y Nick, mientras mantiene vivo el espíritu navideño.
programme.title: Deseos de Navidad
Christmas Wishes & Mistletoe Kisses

programme.desc: Una agente federal debe cuidar a un testigo hasta que testifique ante un jurado justo después de Navidad. Sin embargo, esconderlo de su esposa y de un asesino a sueldo no es tan fácil en una ciudad que se prepara las fiestas.
programme.title: Testigo de Navidad
A Christmas Witness

programme.desc: Justo antes de Navidad, Mary Ann adopta una niña para criarla sola. Ella y el bebé pasan la Navidad atrapados en Bethlehem, Pensilvania, debido al mal tiempo. Su única opción es quedarse con Joe, el hermano del posadero.
programme.title: Milagro en Belén, Pensilvania
Miracle in Bethlehem, PA

programme.desc: Arthur Claus, el hijo torpe de Papá Noel, descubre que una niña no ha recibido su regalo por una falla técnica. En respuesta, se embarca en una misión para salvar su navidad, acompañado de su abuelo, un elfo y ocho renos mágicos.
programme.title: Operación regalo
Arthur Christmas

programme.desc: Un niño se va al Polo Norte en un extraordinario tren. Este viaje asombroso le muestra la maravilla de un mundo mágico, sólo visible para los que creen en él.
programme.title: El expreso polar
The Polar Express

programme.desc: El poco conocido hermano mayor de Santa Claus, Fred, vuelve al Polo Norte, y crea un caos cómico que casi destruye la Navidad antes de demostrar que él no es el perdedor que su hermano menor siempre pensó que era.
programme.title: El hermano de Santa
Fred Claus

programme.desc: Brad y Kate son una guapa y exitosa pareja de San Francisco que ven cómo sus planes iniciales de pasar el día de Navidad en un lugar exótico, alejados de su ciudad y de sus propias familias, se convierten en algo muy diferente.
programme.title: Navidad sin los suegros
Four Christmases

programme.title: T34

programme.title: Cuervos: Suzuran contra Kurosaki

programme.title: El joven Kieslowski

programme.desc: En 1997, la familia Anderson desapareció de su hogar sin dejar rastro. No se encontraron nunca los cuerpos. Durante diecisiete años la casa ha permanecido inalterada... hasta ahora.
programme.title: El origen del terror en Amityville
The Unspoken

programme.desc: Una niña irrumpe en el consultorio psiquiátrico de su casa alegando que una entidad se está alimentando de ella, Jordan y su madre clarividente deben encontrar la manera de detener la fuerza antes de que se lleven a la niña por completo.
programme.title: Criatura voraz
It Feeds

programme.desc: Durante la II Guerra Mundial, un grupo de prisioneros ingleses se encuentra encarcelado en un campo militar del norte de África. Allí sufren la ira de un sádico sargento.
programme.title: La colina de la deshonra
The Hill

programme.title: Infiltrado en el Norte
Gongjak

programme.desc: S1 E16 — Venganza denegada Saúl despierta del coma, junto a Altagracia, y jura venganza contra Felipe. La Doña lo disuade. Miguel Preciado reconoce a uno de sus cómplices, un coronel. Valeria seduce a Lopecito.
programme.title: La doña

programme.desc: S1 E17 — Una velada casi perfecta Victoria disfruta una agradable velada en casa de Jerónimo, pero una visita inesperada irrumpe y arruina el momento.
programme.title: Victoria

programme.desc: S1 E7 — El día después Victoria y Enrique consiguen hablar con sinceridad sobre su matrimonio. Jerónimo idea un plan para acercarse a Victoria. Mariana conoce a Pacho, quien podría traerle problemas.
programme.title: Victoria

programme.desc: S12 E123 — El secreto peligroso / Culpa y capricho Carolina dice que Patricia oculta un pasado que afecta la relación, pero en su defensa, ella le reprocha haberlo destapado. / Un hombre quiere el divorcio de su esposa, porque él se siente como un depravado sexual.
programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.desc: S12 E124 — Hermanos enemigos / Agua bendita Supuestamente Juan participó en el secuestro y de la muerte, de parte de la familia de Abel. / Debby subastó el agua de unos baños que se tomó, pero su amigo Josué quiere la mitad del dinero ganado.
programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.desc: S1 E42 — El coraje de todos Luis les plantea a Jimena y Aurora que vivan todos juntos en poligamia. Alex se presenta en la clase de Fernando y expone su situación de identidad. Remedios toma una decisión sobre su futuro, ha decidido divorciarse de Max.
programme.title: 100 días para enamorarnos

programme.desc: S1 E43 — El ataque Álex recibe amenazas en su casa y Remedios no sabe cómo ayudarlo. A Frida se le escapan noticias sobre su padre frente a Pablo, quien termina enredándose con José Miguel y Fernando descubre lo acontecido.
programme.title: 100 días para enamorarnos

programme.desc: S1 E44 — No hay dos sin tres Alex recibe muestras de apoyo, las cuales agradece. Connie le pregunta a Plutarco si planea tener hijos con Gloria. Alex desea jugar fútbol en el equipo de la escuela, su anhelo conlleva problemas de transfobia.
programme.title: 100 días para enamorarnos

programme.desc: S1 E45 — Inoportunos Roger entrevista a Alex y a sus aliados en un reportaje especial, donde queda expuestas las vejaciones y discriminaciones a las que ha sido sometido. Luis visita inesperadamente la casa de Jimena, donde lo reciben sus dos hijos.
programme.title: 100 días para enamorarnos

programme.desc: S1 E46 — El cuarto poder Pablo y Remedios reciben una propuesta de negocios por parte de José Miguel, Remedios se muestra muy entusiasmada. Un expediente en la oficina de Connie tienta a Roger. Aurora y Jimena piensan en divorciarse de Luis.
programme.title: 100 días para enamorarnos

programme.desc: S1 E47 — Olfato de sabuesos Connie obliga a Roger a confesar el robo de información del expediente del caso Quintero. Alex se prueba para el equipo de fútbol. Emiliano le pide a Ramiro que acepte su dinero para ayudar a Remedios, pues es su deber como padre biológico.
programme.title: 100 días para enamorarnos

programme.title: Juego de villanos

programme.title: Juego de villanos

programme.desc: S12 E113 — Las tres gracias / El coro Jotsy es demandado por tres mujeres, a quienes estafó al casarse con ellas y luego abandonarlas/ Ángela quiere que la reintegren en el coro, pero la directora no la acepta de regreso.
programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.desc: S12 E118 — No se consumó / Fornicando la tierra La abogada Ana María Polo está lista para enfrentarse a cualquier situación y resolver de una vez por todas cualquier polémica.
programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.desc: S12 E106 — No más indocumentados / Borracha manajenado carro de juguete Andrés acusa a Gregory por racista, lo culpa de la deportación de su padre/ María causa un accidente al conducir un auto de juguete bajo efectos del alcohol, su hermana la demanda.
programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.desc: S12 E107 — Me convertí en otra persona / Orgía VIH Cristopher es un hombre heterosexual, casado y con hijos, que siente la necesidad de vestirse de mujer/ Carolina quiere tener sexo con Jorge para contraer VIH, pero él cree que es una locura.
programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.desc: S12 E108 — Microchip para mi madre / O te casas o te mueres Manuela quiere someter a su madre a una cirugía para implantarle un microchip en su cerebro. / Eliana le pide matrimonio a la hija de Liliana mediante un video, pero con una soga al cuello.
programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.desc: S12 E109 — A corazón abierto / A los 70 también se termina Daniela pide que desconecten a su hija con muerte cerebral para tomar su corazón. Sin embargo, la potencial donante está embarazada y su pareja se opone. Por otro lado, una anciana exige el divorcio por falta de atención.
programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.desc: S1 E15 — El bien y el mal La policía investiga la desaparición de una mujer de 23 años de un centro comercial en Plano, Texas.
programme.title: Dateline en español

programme.desc: S1 E16 — Frenético La policía investiga si el asesinato de un abogado del sur de Florida está relacionado con una red de fraude, traición y más de mil millones de dólares desaparecidos.
programme.title: Dateline en español

programme.desc: S1 E17 — Traición Contra todo pronóstico, una joven es encontrada con vida después de que ella y una amiga fueran atacadas cerca de Corpus Christi, Texas.
programme.title: Dateline en español

programme.desc: S12 E116 — Los no nacidos / Mi abuelo, el influencer Sol quiere abrir un cementerio para bebés no nacidos, pero su esposo se niega. / Un influencer tenía un acuerdo con una funeraria para darle promoción. Descubren que sus seguidores eran falsos.
programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.desc: S12 E117 — No tengo cara / Patineta mortal Alegnis se arrepintió después de haberse sometido a diez cirugías estéticas para convertirse en la copia de la exesposa de su marido. / Carolina causó un accidente mortal con una patineta.
programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.desc: S12 E110 — Niño homofóbico / Dame el dinero ladrona Un niño de doce años encontró a su padre con otro hombre y empezó a tener un comportamiento homofóbico, aunque su madre lo apoya por despecho. / Bárbara acusa a su cuñada por la muerte de su hermano.
programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.desc: S12 E111 — Happy Hour / Pequeño campeón Daniela se defiende de una difamación, en su empresa hay una habitación para que sus empleados tengan sexo. / Lorenzo demanda a su madre, por su culpa no pudo ser un pelotero profesional.
programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.desc: S1 E62 — Una semilla de fe La madre de Marcela se empeña en separar a su hija de Javier, sin considerar el daño que les hace a su nieta y a toda la familia. La niña está a punto de quedarse sin primera comunión, pero no pierde la fe.
programme.title: Historias de la Virgen Morena

programme.desc: S1 E63 — Después de la tormenta Anita trabaja como servicio doméstico y se enamora de Javier, el joven de la casa. Sin embargo, después de un terrible accidente, él se deja seducir por Eloísa, una mujer llena de intenciones ocultas.
programme.title: Historias de la Virgen Morena

programme.desc: S1 E48 — Un corazón para dos Daniel participa en una batalla de DJ local, donde Lucía sorprende a Álex, lo quiere ver como algo más que un amigo. Por otro lado, Mariana recibe un mensaje aterrador. Jimena llama a Darío para una cita nocturna que promete mucha lascivia.
programme.title: 100 días para enamorarnos

programme.desc: S1 E49 — Una bomba a punto de explotar Álex usa el baño de hombres en la escuela, hecho que encoleriza a sus compañeros y Martha, la directora, se pone del lado de los susodichos. Connie atrae a Carla, una admiradora, que siente afinidad hacia ella.
programme.title: 100 días para enamorarnos

programme.desc: S1 E50 — Un coqueteo picante Plutarco presencia una interacción confusa entre su esposa y Carla. Connie le enseña a Marta un precedente legal, con lo cual pretende hacerla entrar en razón. Carla le pide a Connie que tengan sexo del bueno.
programme.title: 100 días para enamorarnos

programme.desc: S2 E17 — Se desata la guerra Los Zopilotes van camino a la bodega, mientras Roxana recibe una advertencia del Pichileiro. Inicia la batalla entre los carteles y la cocaína de Rodiles está en juego. Alicia tiene otra misión.
programme.title: Enemigo íntimo

programme.desc: S2 E18 — Veinticuatro horas para matar Don Jesús le da 24 horas a Alicia para envenenar a Roxana, a cambio de la vida de su mamá. Alicia intenta acercarse, pero la Puma no la deja. Luego de varios intentos, la cena está a su alcance.
programme.title: Enemigo íntimo

programme.desc: S2 E19 — La revancha Roxana tiene planes para vengarse de los Zopilotes y comienza con el Rey. Siembra la desconfianza entre él y el Habanero. Está dispuesta a castrarlo, pero él intenta evitarlo de cualquier modo.
programme.title: Enemigo íntimo

programme.desc: S2 E20 — La confesión Roxana presiona para sacar la información que busca. Alerta a Alan y a Ricardo que la policía los espía. Mueve los hilos para callar a Ferrer y su idea suena mejor que simplemente matarlo.
programme.title: Enemigo íntimo

programme.desc: S2 E21 — Siembra la droga Morillo vigila de cerca, pero lo interceptan y a menos que colabore, usarán una prueba contra él. Tiene una misión y debe cumplirla rápida y eficientemente, en la estación de policía.
programme.title: Enemigo íntimo

programme.desc: S2 E22 — Alejandro es el blanco Diego tiene pruebas que arruinarían la carrera de Ferrer, mientras él debe justificar sus acciones, incluso le recomiendan ayuda profesional tras golpear a un subalterno.
programme.title: Enemigo íntimo

programme.desc: S2 E23 — Es el gran día El camión está listo para cargar toda la mercancía. Abel, el Pastor, advierte que no es el mismo de siempre y Lidia se pone nerviosa. Roxana y sus aliadas le siguen la pista con el rastreador.
programme.title: Enemigo íntimo

programme.desc: S2 E24 — Maniobras Ferrer enfrenta el interrogatorio y se quiebra al recordar a David. No sabe dónde lo trasladarán. Carmen y Manuel son sus únicos aliados. Roxana usa su poder para ubicarlo donde más le conviene.
programme.title: Enemigo íntimo

programme.desc: S1 E65 — La felicidad no se compra Al perder a su padre, Ariadna y su familia quedan en la ruina, lo que provoca un completo cambio en su vida. Una oportunidad para aprender que la felicidad no se compra con dinero.
programme.title: Historias de la Virgen Morena

programme.desc: S1 E66 — Los ojos de una madre Aminta enloquece por un amor. Su madre, Leonor, intenta hacerla recapacitar mientras lucha contra el cáncer, pero sin que su hija lo sepa. El tiempo le da la razón y descubre a su verdadero amor, Ricardo.
programme.title: Historias de la Virgen Morena

programme.desc: S2 E9 — La vida que llevo entre mis brazos Rafael pierde a su esposa durante el parto de su hija, razón por la cual, termina repudiando a su progenitora, negandose a cuidarla. Sin embargo, una difícil situación en el parque, cambia la perspectiva del padre.
programme.title: Historias de la Virgen Morena

programme.desc: S1 E69 — Libertad robada Aída es acusada de fraude, condenada injustamente a prisión y obligada a dejar a su bebé. Después de tantos años que decidida a luchar por recuperar lo que le robaron.
programme.title: Historias de la Virgen Morena

Viejas alianzas y nuevas tensiones hacen que el reencuentro sea más complicado de lo habitual, y Jake deberá decidir si puede confiar nuevamente en su viejo 'frenemigo'. Mientras tanto, Amy y Charles se embarcan en una misión casi tan importante como una operación policial: encontrar la máquina expendedora perfecta para la comisaría. Entre pruebas de snacks, debates sobre opciones saludables y conflictos de preferencias, su búsqueda se convierte en una odisea tan cómica como caótica. Comedia. B15. 2013. EE. UU.

programme.desc: S3 — Palabras y hechos House continúa con su lucha con Tritter, el policía que le persigue, ahora debe responder ante un tribunal, en el juicio por la acusación de tenencia de narcóticos y resistencia a la autoridad. Cuddy intenta convencer a House de que ya ha sido suficiente y que lo mejor es que se disculpe con Tritter. Por otra parte en el hospital, tienen que encargarse del caso de Derek Hoyt, un bombero que sufre altas temperaturas en su cuerpo y desorientaciones extremas. El equipo en un primer momento cree que se debe a un desequilibrio hormonal, pero el tratamiento que le ponen además de no conseguir que el paciente mejore, reacciona violentamente. Salvar al paciente en esta ocasión es más complicado de lo habitual, porque tanto House como su equipo, están más preocupado por saber cómo se resolverá el juicio que quizá haga perder el trabajo de House. En este capítulo House va a rehabilitación por cuenta propia. Drama. B. 2004. EE. UU.
programme.title: House M.D.

Mientras, la familia del enfermo se niega a darle un tratamiento experimental, le pone trabas a todo y discute constantemente con la novia del chico. Por otro lado, todas las pruebas dan negativo y no se observa nada en los escáneres del hospital. Drama. B. 2004. EE. UU.

programme.title: House M.D.

programme.desc: S3 — Medio lelo Patrick Obyedkov es un prodigio musical de 35 años. Durante un concierto sufre dolorosas contracciones musculares en su mano izquierda. Ingresa al Princeton Plainsboro Hospital con un extraño trastorno del movimiento y llama la atención inmediata de House. House conversa con el Dr. Obyedkov, padre de Patrick, y descubre que Patrick sufrió un daño cerebral severo a los diez años en un accidente automovilístico que además se cobró la vida de su madre. House siente intriga en saber por qué Patrick, un saludable niño de 10 años sin conocimiento musical alguno antes del accidente ahora toca el piano en forma impecable como consecuencia del daño cerebral sufrido. Solicita una batería de estudios a pesar de que el equipo le diagnostica una simple contractura muscular. Drama. B. 2004. EE. UU.
programme.title: House M.D.

programme.desc: S3 — Confidencial House está desconcertado e intrigado luego de conocer a su nuevo paciente John Kelley, un ex soldado que le salvó la vida en un sueño muy realista que tuvo la noche anterior. Está atónito ya que no comprende cómo apareció en su sueño si no se conocían. Kelley acaba de regresar de dos años de servicio en Irak y muestra síntomas de fatiga, dolor y otros males no específicos que dice son el resultado del Síndrome de la Guerra del Golfo. Al igual que los doctores del Centro de Veteranos, el equipo no cree en la veracidad de ese síndrome pero como su tío es un importante benefactor del hospital deben investigar el caso a fondo. Drama. programme.desc: S3 — Medio lelo Patrick Obyedkov es un prodigio musical de 35 años. Durante un concierto sufre dolorosas contracciones musculares en su mano izquierda. Ingresa al Princeton Plainsboro Hospital con un extraño trastorno del movimiento y llama la atención inmediata de House. House conversa con el Dr. Obyedkov, padre de Patrick, y descubre que Patrick sufrió un daño cerebral severo a los diez años en un accidente automovilístico que además se cobró la vida de su madre. House siente intriga en saber por qué Patrick, un saludable niño de 10 años sin conocimiento musical alguno antes del accidente ahora toca el piano en forma impecable como consecuencia del daño cerebral sufrido. Solicita una batería de estudios a pesar de que el equipo le diagnostica una simple contractura muscular. Drama. B. 2004. EE. UU.

programme.desc: S3 — Transmisión aérea House y Cuddy toman un vuelo de regreso a los Estados Unidos desde Singapur, donde participaron de una conferencia internacional. Poco después de despegar, el pasajero al lado de House se enferma. House no le presta atención ya que cree es una simple resaca. Cuddy sospecha que el hombre tiene un virus mortal de alto contagio y todos los pasajeros corren riesgo. Piensa en la peor de las situaciones y siguiere que el avión debe regresar y aterrizar lo antes posible. House convence a la azafata y el vuelo continúa su curso normalmente. El estado de salud del hombre empeora y los pasajeros comienzan a sentirse intranquilos. También House ahora que otro hombre cae enfermo con la misma erupción y los mismos síntomas. En el Princeton Plainsboro, Wilson lidera el equipo que recibe a Fran, una mujer de mediana edad que se desmayó en su casa e inmediatamente entró en estado convulsivo. Drama. B. 2004. EE. UU.
